description: Saves or updates one direction of a usual train journey (a commute) in the person’s Untap account: stations, usual departure time, travel days and day-ticket fare. An outward and a homeward journey are two separate routes. Saving the same route and time again updates it. Nothing is checked automatically; a saved route is checked only on request. Day tickets only; season tickets are not supported. Requires sign-in to Untap.

commute_id.description: The id of an existing commute in this account, to update or restore it. When left out, a new route is saved.

departure_time.description: Usual UK departure time, for example 08:05 or 8am.

from.description: Departure station name or three-letter code.

label.description: Optional short name such as Morning commute.

ticket_price_pence.description: Usual day-ticket price in pence, £24.50=2450. Optional, for when the fare is known and stays the same. A day-ticket price, not a weekly or monthly season price.

ticket_type.description: Day ticket type. For return, the price is the whole return fare. Season tickets are not supported by saved commutes.

to.description: Arrival station name or three-letter code.

weekdays.description: Usual travel days: Monday=1 through Sunday=7. Informational only; no automatic checks.

name: save_commute
title: Save a usual train journey
